summary: Backend + Frontend testing for KKN-PLP Group 66. Ran 24 pytest tests (23 passed, 1 failed). Verified public site (hero, 15 team members, 6 programs, 7 timeline, empty gallery/videos states) and full admin flow (login, dashboard stats, Team CRUD via UI with search + confirm-delete toast, Settings save, logout redirect). Found one production bug: /api/upload returns an internal cluster URL (http://...cluster-5.preview.emergentcf.cloud) via request.base_url which is NOT publicly accessible (returns 403); only the storageKey served via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is reachable.

critical.issue: Response 'url' field is constructed from request.base_url which resolves to the internal cluster hostname (http://kkn-integrated.cluster-5.preview.emergentcf.cloud/api/files/...) and returns 403 Forbidden when fetched externally. Frontend/browser cannot render uploaded images via this URL. Only /api/files/{storageKey} on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL works. Fix: build the returned URL using an env var (e.g. PUBLIC_BASE_URL / REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) or return only storageKey and let the frontend prefix REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.

action_items: Fix /api/upload to return a publicly reachable URL (use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL / PUBLIC_BASE_URL env var instead of request.base_url) so uploaded images render in the browser.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L162-163: request.base_url on this platform resolves to the internal cluster URL and breaks the returned image URL. Prefer an explicit env var or return only storageKey.
seed() in server.py always rehashes the admin password on startup when it doesn't match the hash - minor but works. Consider skipping when password already valid to reduce startup cost.
settings admin UI does not use the documented `field-{name}` data-testid pattern (uses standard labels/inputs) - not blocking but inconsistent with ResourceManager convention.
seed_data_creation: None. Seed data auto-populated by backend startup (15 team, 6 programs, 7 timeline, 6 news, 6 archives, 8 memories, 1 location, settings).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL is REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://kkn-integrated.preview.emergentagent.com. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. All CRUD, auth, settings, activity-logs, health endpoints pass. Only failing test: TestUpload::test_upload_png_success asserts the returned url is fetchable externally - it returns 403 because request.base_url resolves internally. Sidebar test-ids follow slug of the label (Team Members -> sidebar-team-members, not sidebar-team).
rca of the issue: In server.py upload_file(): `base = str(request.base_url).rstrip('/')` uses the internal Kubernetes cluster hostname that Starlette sees from the incoming forwarded request. That URL (http://...cluster-5.preview.emergentcf.cloud) is not exposed publicly (returns 403 from ingress). Reproduction: POST /api/upload with a PNG using the public URL; inspect data.url in the response; GET that URL externally -> 403. Mitigation: (a) prefer env var like `PUBLIC_BASE_URL` or reuse `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL` server-side; (b) OR return only `storageKey` and have the frontend build the URL as `${REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api/files/${storageKey}`; (c) OR trust X-Forwarded-Host/Proto headers via a proxy middleware.
